regeneration_reason: Updated in the same change set as the sanitize-html dependency/runtime remediation and the evidence-panel presentation follow-up. The dependency boundary now requires Node 22.12, and the evidence feedback style is explicitly separated from the shared panel shadow.

nodes.label: Web Entry
nodes.role: Loads global styles and the evidence-specific follow-up override before rendering App.

nodes.label: Web App Shell
nodes.role: Authentication, dashboard, projects and user-administration shell.

nodes.label: Project Workspace
nodes.role: Project tabs and composition of design, run, Excel/export and recycle-bin panels.

nodes.label: Run Workspace
nodes.role: Run execution and evidence UI. EvidencePanel renders section.panel.evidence-panel and direct success/error feedback.

nodes.label: Shared UI Styles
nodes.role: Global tokens and generic .panel elevation used across the product.

nodes.label: Evidence Follow-up Style
nodes.role: Overrides the generic .panel shadow only for .evidence-panel and applies the same top margin to direct success and error feedback.
constraints: Evidence panel uses border without shadow.
Direct success and error feedback use the same top spacing.

nodes.label: Evidence and Procedure Routes
nodes.role: Evidence CRUD and retained procedure CRUD. GET /api/procedures/:id renders stored Markdown with renderSafeMarkdown before returning preview HTML.

nodes.label: Markdown Sanitizer
nodes.role: Renders Markdown with marked then sanitizes HTML with sanitize-html. SVG and SMIL animation tags are not allowlisted and only http/https schemes are accepted.
constraints: Script, iframe, images and dangerous URL schemes are removed.
SVG SMIL advisory payloads must not survive sanitization.

nodes.label: Web Dependency Manifests
nodes.role: Locks sanitize-html to the patched 2.17.7 line. The package engine requires Node >=22.12.0.

nodes.label: Web Node Runtime
nodes.role: Pins local, CI and container runtime to Node 22.12.0 and raises the dependency audit gate to moderate.

nodes.label: Fastify API Core
nodes.role: Core HTTP application, authentication and request transaction hooks.

nodes.label: MariaDB Persistence
nodes.role: MariaDB pool and request-local transaction boundary.

flows.label: Evidence feedback presentation
constraints: Outer evidence panel and evidence cards have no shadow.
Success and error feedback both have at least the evidence feedback top spacing.
No API, DB or upload semantics change.

flows.label: Procedure Markdown security
constraints: Node 22.12.0 is used in CI and production container.
SVG SMIL URL-scheme bypass payloads are removed by the configured allowlist.
